NZ Pacer Duffy Eager to Face RCB Teammate Kohli

New Zealand pace bowler Jacob Duffy expressed his anticipation for potentially playing against his Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) teammate Virat Kohli during an upcoming ODI series. Duffy stated it would be 'awesome' to compete against Kohli.
